scope: Changed solver client and photon-transport application surfaces; selective static inspection and targeted adversarial regression tests. No rerun of unchanged published campaigns.

findings.observation: Missing input/output length checks reach indexing loops; short slices panic and excess entries are not rejected.
findings.impact: Malformed diagnostic API calls can panic instead of returning typed errors; driver-internal sweep uses validated dimensions.
findings.repair: Validate both dimensions before any output mutation; test short and oversized input and output for one- and two-level preconditioners.

findings.observation: Invalid shift exits before clearing Factored state.
findings.impact: A failed factor update leaves old factors usable by solve, apply and precondition. Driver-generated positive shifts did not exercise this misuse in published results.
findings.repair: Invalidate factor state before shift validation while retaining linearization for a corrected retry.

findings.observation: Driver increments linear_solves before client call and nested solve_gmres_into increments it again on success.
findings.impact: Successful Krylov stages count twice in work telemetry; direct client does not. Numerical trajectory is unaffected.
findings.repair: Accumulate nested Krylov work except driver-owned linear_solves, including work on error.

coverage: shape errors without output mutation in both preconditioner modes
invalid shift invalidates every factor consumer and allows valid retry
nested GMRES preserves driver-owned solve count while retaining Krylov work
dense LU residual and backward error
driver allocation count independent of attempt count

observations: short preconditioner input index out of bounds len9 index9
solve remained usable after failed factor update

environment_interruption.detail: Default-concurrency dependency compilation interrupted after memory pressure before tests started; rerun used two jobs and zero debug information; target cache preserved.

production_assessment.scoped: Fixed-grid, unpolarized, non-tilted Bianchi-I and specified chemistry test cases have published application-budget evidence; adoption requires matching physical/model/accuracy assumptions.
remaining: Spatial discretization and angular/energy refinement error separate from temporal-reference agreement.
Accumulated remesh approximation error and positivity policy are not controlled by local RODAS estimate.
Full-sphere structured linear solver and polarized/tilted/recoil physics are not implemented in this branch.
Application modules remain example-owned rather than a stable reusable domain crate.
NCP timings have documented unequal scopes and support diagnostic comparisons only.

complementary_review.result: No functional defect in bounded static check of augmentation sign, transpose, packing, capacities, atomic output and mutex access.
complementary_review.documentation_finding: Failure paths allocate error Strings; promise zero allocation only for successful applications.

workflow.review_budget: One complementary code-review pass; no recursive reviews and no historical campaign reruns.
